bug_locations: dependency_order function - nodes collection (missing referenced-only nodes)
dependency_order function - missing in_ready set for correct heap membership tracking
explanation: Three bugs: (1) `nodes` only included dict keys, missing nodes that appear only as dependencies in values — fixed by also adding all values to `nodes`. (2) Membership check `m not in ready` is unreliable on a heap list and could cause duplicates — fixed by maintaining a separate `in_ready` set. (3) No cycle detection — fixed by checking if `len(out) != len(nodes)` after the loop and raising `ValueError`.
